text: A male figure, likely late teens to early adulthood, with a stocky build and pale skin. He has long, straight black hair falling past shoulders, a broad face with heavy brows, and a stern expression. Wearing a deep red sleeveless tunic with fringed hem, matching shorts, gold arm bands, a gold breastplate, and brown sandals. Gold greaves cover lower legs. Standing front-facing, arms at sides, looking directly forward. Other panels show side and rear views of same outfit.
